syntheticSource.scope: Task-local synthetic performance fixture; no source or coverage evidence
syntheticSource.qualification: Window initialized synthetically; background provider maintenance revised some bars before pinning. Matrix comparisons use the actual post-maintenance cache with the reported matching before/after hash, not the original seed hash. No source-completeness evidence.

conditions: Each lane/count cell starts by restarting API/native worker and PostgreSQL processes; first browser sample follows that restart, next two use resident processes, all use fresh browser contexts. OS page cache and database contents are retained. Bootstrap reads main history before indicator timer starts; this is not a cold database end-to-end measurement.
History workers paused and task-only wrapper prevents synthetic symbol cache misses from fetching live data. Fixed fixture wall clock does not freeze monotonic or CPU timings.

Five real main-history extensions per sample wait for all indicator start times to align; loaded bars and page sizes differ and are reported. p50/p95 use floor(n*p) order statistic over 15 page timings per cell; sample count is small.
Counts 1/4/8 repeat identical period5 LWMA; shared reads do not represent different algorithm costs. Native lane uses built-in WMA.

First pixel polls large plot canvases for temporary magenta curve. Scanning adds CPU/heap. CDP heap and renderer timing include parent UI. API RSS is process high water, cumulative over resident samples; SQL includes driver/roundtrip, spans can overlap concurrent requests.
Final event/dataReady/versioned in-flight reuse product code for all new-python cells. No concurrent browser tests or builds during matrix. Measurements are not pooled with earlier code/matrices.

Completed, started, failed/cancelled and unfinished HTTP reads are reported separately at the measurement boundary. Captures drain before context close. Old-python/4 was rerun after a capture-only shutdown failure; that failed process is excluded from this evidence.

Each cell has one post-process-restart sample and two resident samples. Both bootstrap main history before the indicator timer. Neither is a strict OS-cache-cold database experiment. No fixed speed ratio or equality with native is claimed.
SQL/backend/calculation spans sum completed profiled requests and may overlap in wall time; renderer task/script/layout/style are cumulative CDP deltas rather than exclusive paint spans.
